question.title: Number of Squareful Arrays
question.content: An array is <strong>squareful<strong> if the sum of every pair of adjacent elements is a <strong>perfect square<strong>.Given an integer array nums, return <em>the number of permutations of <em><code>nums<code><em> that are <strong>squareful<strong><em>.Two permutations <code>perm1<code> and <code>perm2<code> are different if there is some index <code>i<code> such that <code>perm1[i] != perm2[i]<code>. <strong class="example">Example 1:<strong><pre><strong>Input:<strong> nums = [1,17,8]<strong>Output:<strong> 2<strong>Explanation:<strong> [1,8,17] and [17,8,1] are the valid permutations.<pre><strong class="example">Example 2:<strong><pre><strong>Input:<strong> nums = [2,2,2]<strong>Output:<strong> 1<pre> <strong>Constraints:<strong><ul>	<li><code>1 <= nums.length <= 12<code><li>	<li><code>0 <= nums[i] <= 10<sup>9<sup><code><li><ul>
